name: chartguard
description: Chart.js, ECharts and Highcharts configs checked in JavaScript and TypeScript as you type, with the runtime's own renames as quick fixes

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, ChartGuard reads only your user settings: a workspace could otherwise point it at files to read (a tsconfig, plugin schemas).

chartguard.libraryVersion.description: Exact versions by library (chartjs, echarts, highcharts), or "auto" for the version installed for each file.

chartguard.extensions.description: Plugin schemas by library, as --plugin-schema takes them.

chartguard.patterns.description: Your own wrappers that hand a config to a chart library.

chartguard.quality.description: Rule levels, ignores, page context and ruleset for the quality review, as quality --settings takes them.

chartguard.project.description: Read each file with its project's tsconfig through its imports: true for the nearest tsconfig, or a tsconfig path relative to the workspace.
